scope: Complete class_identity target: two actual external Cinch frontend build/run cases, one direct Native wrong-evidence rejection. No Native frontend fallback. Not complete frontend parity.
mechanism: Portable common::build/run dispatch selects the explicit external wrapper. It invokes only the actual Cinch-built compiler --emit-ir with admitted base interfaces and the pinned library object, then clang with the matching runtime. Selected compiler errors never fall back to Native.
